title: Harness guard exemption ladder -- implementation howto (phases, adapters, joseki)
desc: Exemption ladder implementation: 3-phase execution, stall accounting, cross-family R1-R6, family adapter contract, joseki-guidance, knowledge-score.
steps: EXECUTION ORDER 3 PHASES (strictly in order): PHASE 1 EMERGENCY SAFETY = stop the brick NOW: real /usage anchor + expiring temp bridge so pace reflects truth, AND make knowledge-ification + harness-source self-repair always-pass. STATUS DONE 2026-06-10 (anchor seed 0pct, pace short-circuit, stall wk/skill exemption, Skill tool pace-exempt). PHASE 2 PROBLEM SOLVING = implement single TIER0/1/2 ladder + isKnowledgeOp/isHarnessSourceEdit helpers, REMOVE scattered per-guard exemptions, consolidate duplicate stall-guard into one, fix reset-on-user-turn. PHASE 3 RECURRENCE PREVENTION = harness self-test green, confirm knowledge + source edits pass even at 95pct+ pace, knowledge-ify the ladder into stall-guard-wk-exemption + claude-md-harness-rules, assert SACRED-surface principle.|CONSOLIDATE: merge duplicate stall-guard (wkharness-guards-infra.ps1 vs wkharness-guards.ps1 ~line1012) into one implementation, fix reset-on-user-turn so a fresh user message clears the stall window. Keep Claude-family /usage anchor corrector (wkharness-guards-pace-claude-usage.ps1) plus expiring temp bridge for pace accuracy. VERIFY: run harness self-test and confirm knowledge ops AND harness-source edits pass even at 95pct+ pace. Then knowledge-ify the new ladder into stall-guard-wk-exemption and claude-md-harness-rules skills.|PHASE 2 DETAIL -- stall accounting includes read-only tools: read-only built-in tools and TIER0 exempt ops MUST STILL update stall-window accounting (firstToolAt/lastToolAt read-modify-write) even though never BLOCKED. Only the BLOCK decision is skipped for exempt/read-only. Hoist stall-state update so it runs for ALL tools BEFORE any early-exit/allow, then apply block decision only for TIER2. Without this, a read-heavy grind looks idle, 300s-since-lastToolAt check falsely resets the window, stall-guard fires inconsistently. Counting reads makes solo-loop duration accurate.|SIMPLIFICATION (Opus review 2026-06-10): first pass had two smells: (a) read-only stall accounting duplicated in wkharness-guards.ps1 AND wkharness-guards-infra.ps1; (b) guard modules dot-sourced in TWO branches. FIX to single linear flow: classify once -> if tier0 exit0 -> if tier1 {study-lock; exit0} -> if NOT read-only run pace guard -> dot-source guard modules EXACTLY ONCE. Read-only tools fall through to single dot-source; stall accounting+block lives in ONE place (infra.ps1). DELETE hoisted read-only accounting block in wkharness-guards.ps1 -- reads are counted because they reach infra. Net: one classification, one pace decision, one module dot-source, one stall implementation. Also finish pending: cross-family R1-R6, family adapter contract, auto-calibration-on-block wiring, reset-on-user-turn fix, consolidate duplicate stall-guard.|CROSS-FAMILY RULES R1-R6 (DEFINITIVE -- Claude/Codex/Gemini/agy/GPT): R1 NORMALIZE-FIRST: map every family native tool name to canonical set (Read/Glob/Grep/LS/Edit/Write/Bash/Skill/Agent/Todo*/Task*) and populate filePath BEFORE ladder classifies, so TIER0 + read-only + harness-source detection is family-agnostic. R2 Knowledge-support set and read-only set defined ONLY on canonical names + path patterns -- ONE ladder serves all families. R3 PACE stays family-branched: Claude=JSONL+/usage anchor; Gemini=wkgemini_usage.jsonl; Codex=codex_balance.json. NEVER score one family with another family counter. R4 STALL must read ACTIVE family session + user-turn signal keyed by family-qualified sessionId; a family whose session cannot be located must not inherit another family stall window. R5 SUBAGENTS detected via WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL are exempt from stall; ensure spawn propagates it. R6 FAIL-OPEN ON UNCERTAINTY: if family cannot be determined OR session log cannot be parsed, guard MUST ALLOW (exit 0), never block. Every per-family parse wrapped in try/catch defaulting to ALLOW.|AUTO-CALIBRATION ON WOULD-BE-BLOCK (near-realtime self-correction, user 2026-06-10): when a guard is about to BLOCK because usage exceeds target AND the real-usage anchor is STALE (captured_at older than 60min) OR missing, harness MUST first run on-demand real-usage capture, re-read fresh anchor, and RE-EVALUATE -- block ONLY if real numbers confirm over-target. GATING: cooldown stamp (usage_recalc_<family>.stamp, 60min) written BEFORE capture to prevent block-storm triggers. TIMEOUT: synchronous capture bounded ~15s (job + Wait-Job -Timeout). FAIL-OPEN per R6: if capture errors or times out, ALLOW. Wiring point: pace guard, immediately before each Block call -> call Get-ClaudeUsageAnchorOrRecalibrate and re-test exceeded against returned real percentages. The hourly scheduled task (claude-usage-anchor) keeps the anchor warm so on-demand path rarely fires.|FAMILY ADAPTER CONTRACT (any new family slots in with ZERO core/ladder changes): ONE adapter per family implementing 4 contract members: (1) DETECT Test-Is<Family>(lastModel,toolName,cmd)->bool + tier label, registered in ONE dispatch table NOT scattered if/elseif. (2) TOOLMAP hashtable native-name -> canonical applied BEFORE ladder, must populate filePath for mapped Edit/Write (R1). (3) USAGE Get-<Family>UsageAnchor([MaxAgeMin]) -> {totalPct,sonnetPct,resetUtc} from family OWN source + Invoke-<Family>UsageCapture for on-demand recalibration; FAIL-OPEN to null. (4) SESSION Get-<Family>ActiveSession -> {path,lastUserTurnTs} for stall accounting + reset-on-user-turn (R4), FAIL-OPEN. CLAUDE IS THE REFERENCE IMPL (Get-ClaudeUsageAnchor + claude-usage-capture.ps1 + Get-WkActiveSessionJsonl + the /usage anchor). ACTIVATION CHECKLIST: copy Claude adapter, point 4 members at family source, add ONE row to dispatch table, run self-test -- NO edits to ladder or core guards. Keep each adapter under ~150 lines.|EMPIRICAL PER-FAMILY USAGE SOURCES (CLI test 2026-06-10): CLAUDE = bare 'claude /usage' (positional slash, NOT -p) prints current session/week percentages -- cleanest, fully parseable. CODEX = NO usage command; 'codex login status' shows auth only; usage from rate-limit events -> codex_balance.json / codex_pace.json. GEMINI = '/stats' interactive-only; 'gemini -p /stats' blocked by trusted-folder gate; usage = wkgemini_usage.jsonl proxy. AGY = minimal Go flags, usage TBD. OLLAMA = local, no quota. IMPLICATION: only Claude has clean CLI usage command; every other family extracts from its own log/proxy -- exactly why R3 mandates per-family sources and R6 fail-open matters. WKDOCTOR consumes these adapter USAGE members for per-family dashboard AND must functionally check + auto-repair each family CLI (claude bin symlink dead target detection + re-link; existence check alone not enough, run functional smoke).|SELF-DOCUMENTING HARNESS FILENAMES (user 2026-06-10): a harness source filename MUST encode its role so any intelligence knows scope, purpose, owner, and edit-rights at a glance with ZERO doc-read. Convention: base = domain path (wkharness-guards-pace), trailing qualifiers = sub-domain or owner (-claude-usage). Scratch SUFFIX doubles as rank/permission tag: NO suffix = canonical live source ROOT-only; -proto/-probe = sandbox/experiment cheap-editable; -<modelname> = that model private scratch. A cheap intelligence routes correctly from the NAME alone -- filename IS the spec. Naming discipline = cheapest possible documentation. Pairs with BULK STUDY-LOCK and CHEAP-AGENT SANDBOX.|KNOWLEDGE-VERIFICATION (skill Require/requa contract patterns, user 2026-06-10): executing a skill requirement contracts IS part of knowledge lifecycle and must not brick. BUT NOT as blanket pattern-whitelist: a skill requirement command can be arbitrary, so auto-exempting any command matching some skill declared requirement is an ABUSE HOLE. SAFE design: requirement-execution is FREE only INSIDE harness-controlled verification flow (harness itself running the contract, tagged as verification-context) -- NOT when an AI types the same command free-form. AND it MUST run against a CLONE/dry-run target, never the live skill (ties to open bug where co-resolve requirement cmds mutate live production skill). NET: knowledge VERIFICATION is free + sandboxed within controlled context; identical command typed free-form stays under normal pace/stall/wk-only. Exemption follows the CONTEXT not the raw command string.|JOSEKI-GUIDANCE PRINCIPLE (user 2026-06-10): every harness signal -- BLOCK message, post-action tip, knowledge-score nudge -- MUST GUIDE the intelligence to the precise correct NEXT MOVE, not merely deny. ACTION-FIRST: lead with what TO DO, then why. A guard that says only 'blocked' wastes a whole turn; one that says 'use X instead because Y' makes next move correct on first try. Live examples: pace block emits 'TRY: Agent.cmd --model agy / wkcodex.sh'; stall block emits 3 numbered escape methods; wkharness-post.ps1 PostToolUse skill-tips emitter (once per 6h alongside knowledge score) pre-warns 5 common skill blocks (encoding-guard=English-only, security-guard=no literal env var names, requirement=subcommand-not-flag, pipe=step-separator, co-resolve=clone) BEFORE they trip. DESIGN TEST: can a cheap intelligence place the correct next stone from this message alone, WITHOUT a blocked retry? If not, rewrite action-first. Pairs with SELF-DOCUMENTING FILENAMES and CHEAP-AGENT SANDBOX.|KNOWLEDGE-SCORE REWARD READING LINKED WEB (user 2026-06-10): when Get-WkTierScore scores a skill, also reflect whether the AUTHORING session actually READ the skills the content links to. Award +1 point per linked skill genuinely read in THIS session (capped +5 max). ANTI-GAMING: (a) only count links to skills that EXIST; (b) only award if linked skill was actually READ in session JSONL; (c) cap bonus so link-spam cannot inflate score; (d) base score stays content-driven. EFFECT: nudges every author to LOAD connected skills first. READ-WINDOW BOUND: bound session-JSONL scan to window [max(skill-created-or-edited-time, now-minus-1-month) .. now]. lowerBound = max(skillCreatedOrEditedAt, now-30d); count a linked skill as read only if a 'skill read <id>' event exists in session JSONL within [lowerBound, now]. Implement in Get-WkTierScore: parse skill body for skill references, intersect with set of skills read this session (from session JSONL), add min(5, count) to score.|BULK STUDY-LOCK ON SANDBOX SOURCE (user 2026-06-10): sandbox/draft source a delegate works on should carry a harness:skill STUDY-LOCK so the delegate connects reflexes before editing. PROBLEM: a sub-pro like Haiku cannot reliably AUTHOR the study-lock tag itself (chicken-and-egg). SOLUTION: apply study-lock IN BULK via a single harness:skill PATTERN rule declared ONCE by ROOT -- e.g. in CLAUDE.md a glob rule matching the sandbox/draft path (-proto/-probe/-model suffix or scratch dir) plus the skill reads. A pattern rule auto-attaches the lock to EVERY matching file, so any delegate inherits guidance with ZERO authoring. NET: ROOT declares bulk study-lock pattern once; delegates guided automatically. Same principle as agent-on-load but enforced at the FILE the delegate touches, in bulk -- answers the chicken-egg by moving authorship from cheap delegate up to ROOT pattern.|GITIGNORE THE SANDBOX SERIES + SELF-PROVISIONING (user 2026-06-10): (A) .gitignore the -proto and -probe globs makes every sandbox/draft file UNTRACKED by construction -> automatically in FREE zone (any delegate of any grade edits it) -> ROOT promotes by COMMITTING, and the commit IS the gate. Git itself enforces the boundary. COMPOSES with bulk study-lock: a harness:skill PATH pattern still matches the untracked sandbox path, so sandbox file is FREELY editable AND study-locked simultaneously. (B) IF a sub-pro (Haiku) DOES correctly author a harness:skill study-lock tag, that is a strong COMPETENCE SIGNAL earning a real knowledge-score bonus. ANTI-GAMING: reward only VALID parseable directive, capped. (C) SELF-PROVISIONING: harness setup.ps1 idempotently ENSURES .gitignore contains base patterns '*-proto.*' and '*-probe.*'. wkdoctor also CHECKS + HEALS this (same as 08-harness-connection auto-install). When a family is registered via FAMILY ADAPTER CONTRACT, it SELF-ADDS its own model-suffix pattern '-<thatmodel>.*' to .gitignore, gaining a 5th adapter member: DECLARE the family scratch suffix + self-provision its gitignore line at activation. NET: no human ever hand-edits .gitignore for sandboxing; harness ensures base patterns on init and doctor-heal, and each family ensures its own suffix on activation. Self-installing and self-healing.
